The <b>Surface Memento</b> is a [[Materium#Mementos|memento]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>.

== Use ==
The memento can be displayed on a shelf in the [[Bellhome]] after interacting with the desk.

It appears in the bottom-left slot of the shelving.

{{Gallery
|Image1 = Mapshot SS Bellhome.png!Location in Bellhart
|Image2 = Screenshot SS Bellhart 09.png!Displayed inside the Bellhome in Bellhart
}}

== How to Acquire ==
Obtained by playing the [[Needolin]] in a decaying house on the eastern edge of the [[Nameless Town]].
